title: wasm4pm Receipt v2
description: BLAKE3-chained provenance receipt emitted by wpm run and wpm cognition run. Captures all inputs, outputs, and identity fields required for deterministic replay and audit.
$comment: ocel_hash/model_hash/wasm_hash are PARTIAL — present once M4 L1 is complete. signature/public_key_id are PENDING — present once signing infrastructure is implemented.

receipt_version.description: Schema version discriminator. Must be '2.0' for this schema.

breed_id.description: Identifier of the cognition breed or algorithm that produced this receipt.

breed_version.description: Semver or CalVer of the breed/algorithm at time of manufacture.

registry_id.description: Kernel registry identifier — links receipt to the algorithm registry snapshot.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this manufacturing run. Used as filename stem for receipt persistence.

input_hash.description: BLAKE3 hex digest (256-bit, lowercase) of the canonical input payload.

output_hash.description: BLAKE3 hex digest (256-bit, lowercase) of the canonical output payload.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the manufacture completed.

replay_pointer.description: First 16 hex characters of output_hash. Short addressable handle for replay lookup.

status.description: Terminal status of the manufacturing run. 'refused' indicates a policy boundary was triggered.

boundary_id.description: Optional. Identifier of the policy boundary that triggered a refusal. Present only when status is 'refused'.

ocel_hash.description: PARTIAL (M4 L1). BLAKE3 hash of the OCEL event log input, when applicable.

model_hash.description: PARTIAL (M4 L1). BLAKE3 hash of the process model artifact, when applicable.

wasm_hash.description: PARTIAL (M4 L1). BLAKE3 hash of the WASM binary used during manufacture.

registry_hash.description: BLAKE3 hash of the algorithm registry snapshot at time of manufacture.

receipt_hash.description: BLAKE3 hash of this receipt's canonical serialization (excluding this field). Enables chain integrity verification.

signature_algorithm.description: PENDING (signing infrastructure). Algorithm used to sign this receipt.

signature.description: PENDING (signing infrastructure). Base64-encoded signature over the receipt_hash using the declared signature_algorithm.

public_key_id.description: PENDING (signing infrastructure). Identifier of the public key used to verify the signature.

refusal_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why a manufacture was refused. Present only when status is 'refused'.

examples.refusal_reason: Input contract references a remote URI. GGEN-YIELD-005 REMOTE_FETCH_PROHIBITED applies.
